{{Top|leg}}
'''Ordinance Detonation Test Area''', abbreviated '''ODTA''', was a term for areas the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used for testing munitions.

One ODTA was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend VI]] at some point during the Empire's reign. It was eventually abandoned and bought by [[Blizz Pinnix]], a famous [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] and the owner of the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] called [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]], who turned the zone into a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] racecourse known as [[Raptor Run]].

==Behind the scenes==
The term appears exactly once in all of [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]], on page 72 of the [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', where it spelled as above, although it obviously refers to [[Wiktionary:ordnance|ordnance]], not an [[Wiktionary:ordinance|ordinance]].
